WHAT WE DO 

Gecko Robotics is helping the world’s most important organizations ensure the availability, reliability, and sustainability of critical infrastructure. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall-climbing robots, industry-leading sensors, and an AI-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure.




ROLE AT A GLANCE

The Software Platform team’s purpose is to empower software engineers, reduce unnecessary blockers, and increase our velocity to create exceptional products. They do this by making software effortless to build, deploy, and manage. Using automation, shared libraries, and DevOps tools, they solve the common software problems so other engineers can focus on Gecko’s unique challenges.

This role will specifically focus on leveling up our cloud architecture and automation, empowering engineers to manage and own their own deployments without needing extensive cloud expertise. We are looking for someone to become the primary owner of Gecko’s Cloud, supported by the rest of the team.







WHAT YOU WILL DO

Primary owner of Gecko’s Cloud, discovering and designing solutions for a well-architected cloud

 - Operational excellence (i.e. observability)

 - Security, privacy, and compliance

 - Reliability

 - Cost optimization

 - Performance optimization

 - Contribute significantly to the Software Platform team’s other work

 - Smooth, intuitive, automated CI/CD

 - Customer authentication

 - Permission management

 - DevOps Tool management and optimization

 - Optimizing the local development experience

 - Effective onboarding and internal training

 - Enable new business for Gecko by architecting solutions to achieve necessary certifications (e.g. DoD IL4/5)




TECHNOLOGIES WE USE

We use a variety of technologies, but we primarily operate using Python, React, and Typescript with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as our primary cloud provider. Our cloud architecture is primarily serverless, stateless, and event-driven. This is a non-exhaustive list and we are tech agnostic in our interview process, so we encourage you to apply regardless of your background.




ABOUT YOU


REQUIRED SKILLS

 - Previous experience in a DevOps role

 - Strong automation/scripting skills

 - Previous experience with one or more cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure, etc.)

 - Previous experience with Terraform

 - Previous experience with cloud automation, CI/CD, and Docker

 - Proficiency with Linux and command line tools

 - Experience in developing and maintaining technical documentation and procedures

 - Strong communication skills, both verbal and written

 - Ability to work both independently and with cross-functional teams







PREFERRED SKILLS

 - Python

 - Experience working with the US Government (DoD specifically)

 - GCP specific experience




WHO WE ARE

At Gecko, our people are our greatest investment. In addition to competitive compensation packages, we offer company equity, 401(k) matching, gender-neutral parental leave, full medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health, ongoing professional development, family planning assistance, and flexible paid time off. 

Gecko values collaboration, innovation, and partnership, and we believe we do our best work when we're together in person. We’re an office-first culture but understand that sometimes you may need to work from home. Many people are in the office five days a week, others need a bit more flexibility. Ultimately, we care about the outcomes we achieve - and creating a culture of autonomy and trust that enables that impact.

Gecko is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission to protect today’s infrastructure and give form to tomorrow’s. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our critical mission, we’d love to hear from you.

🏥 ABOUT SAILOR HEALTH

Healthcare for older adults is stuck in the past. Today, 93% of Americans aged 65+ live with at least one chronic health condition, yet the care they receive is overwhelmingly reactive instead of preventive and shaped by the misplaced belief that the average 70-year-old can’t use technology.

Sailor Health is defining what modern, AI-native care looks like for older adults. Our virtual platform brings together behavioral health, wellness classes, and healthcare advocacy, with more products on the way. In tandem, our voice AI agents help patients navigate their health between visits, while AI copilots help our providers deliver higher quality, more effective care.

Sailor has exceptional product market fit:

 - Exponential growth: We serve tens of thousands of patients and cover 37 million Medicare lives across all 50 states, with organic demand making Sailor one of the fastest growing companies in healthcare.

 - AI powered, deeply human care: We harness the power of AI while keeping human connection at the center of care, creating an experience that feels personal, continuous, and deeply human.

 - Talent dense team: We are a 25 person team in our NYC office and are backed by the founders of Ramp, Nourish, and Headway.

Learn more about us here: https://www.sailorhealth.com/careers/corporate

 


⭐ ABOUT THE ROLE

Location: New York City (Soho) or Remote.

Sailor is hiring a Full Stack Engineer to join as an early member of our team. You will be given the hardest business problems in the company and asked to figure out how to solve them with software or AI. You will own that work end to end: deciding what to build, building it, launching it, and making sure it moves the numbers that matter.

We are looking for product forward engineers who care as much about the business “why” as the technical “how.” You will work closely with our clinical, operations, and growth teams, and you will often be the one deciding what gets built and why. Your work will shape how thousands of older adults experience their care and live their daily lives.

 


💻 YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build web apps end to end: frontend, backend, system design, testing, and launch, owning the full lifecycle from scoping to measuring impact.
   
   - For patients, that means delightful, accessible experiences that make older adults feel confident with technology and eager to come back.
   
   - For providers, that means tools that give clinicians time back, reduce friction in their day, and measurably improve outcomes for the patients they treat.

 - Build AI agents from the ground up: designing conversations, orchestrating models, evaluating quality, and shipping agents that patients and providers rely on every day.

 - Work directly with our clinical, operations, and growth teams to understand the real problem before deciding what to build.

 - Work at the frontier: build with the newest models and agentic tooling the day they come out, with full freedom to pick the stack and the approach.

 


✅ IDEAL QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

 - You’re an A+ player. You have a burning desire to win, a track record of excellence, and a drive to build with urgency and precision. You want to be the best and you want your team to win.

 - You’re technically excellent. You are comfortable across the stack in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

 - You’re product driven. You have strong intuition for user needs, high EQ, and a deep curiosity to understand the underlying business and clinical problems, not just the technical solution.

 - You thrive in ambiguity. You’re energized by open ended problems and move quickly with imperfect information.

 - You care deeply about people. You want your work to make a real difference in someone’s life, and you bring kindness, honesty, and low ego to how you treat your teammates along the way.
